fonts.weight: font-black for H1/H2, font-bold for widgets
fonts.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) to create a mechanical, precise feel. Do not use default Inter.
Highly legible for dense UI. Critical: use tabular-nums utility class for all tables and metric values to ensure vertical alignment of digits.

rules: Never use pure #000000 for text, use #0A0A0A.
Semantic colors (red/amber) are strictly reserved for state indicators (low stock, errors) and should not be used for decoration.

layouts.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-12 gap-3 md:gap-4. Use col-span-12 md:col-span-3 for KPI metrics. Main charts or tables take col-span-12 md:col-span-8 or 9.
layouts.navigation: Persistent left-rail sidebar (dark mode sidebar #0A0A0A against light mode app #F8F9FA for high structural contrast).
layouts.cards_and_surfaces: Cardless or flat geometric. 1px solid border (#E5E5E5). No heavy drop shadows. Max border-radius: 4px (rounded-sm) for a sharp, technical look.

components_strategy.shadcn_customization: Use Shadcn components but override default rounded corners to rounded-sm. Strip out soft shadows in favor of 1px borders.
components_strategy.tables: Tables are the primary interface. Use compact rows (h-10). Keep padding tight (px-3 py-2). Enable sticky headers for long inventory lists.
components_strategy.forms_inputs: Use Shadcn Input and Select. For order entry, use clear tabular layouts. Active states should have a bold 2px ring of the primary accent color.
components_strategy.alerts: Use Sonner for toasts (placed at bottom-right or top-center). Low stock warnings must use a stark red background with white text for maximum visibility.
components_strategy.buttons: Sharp rectangles (rounded-sm). Solid primary color for primary actions, outline or ghost for secondary. ALWAYS set hover text color explicitly.

motion.strategy: Minimalist and immediate. This is a work tool, not a toy.
motion.interactions: Fast transitions (duration-150). Hovering rows in tables slightly darkens background (hover:bg-gray-50).
motion.loading: Skeleton loaders for data tables rather than spinning indicators.

media.strategy: Minimal imagery. Use industrial textures for the login screen to set a premium tone.

image_urls.description: Clean, modern warehouse concrete flooring for a subtle, professional login background.
Empty warehouse architectural shot, useful for split-screen login layout.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for all text. Alert states must be highly readable.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, table rows, form inputs, export buttons) MUST include data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case based on their role (e.g., 'customer-select-dropdown', 'order-submit-button').
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:outline-none on all inputs and buttons.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 or 2 for clarity. Do not use emojis.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid AI slop: make this dashboard look like a high-end, $10k/month enterprise ERP.
Do not center-align the app container. Data dense apps must be left-aligned or span full width.
Prioritize Shadcn UI for all complex interactive components. DO NOT build raw HTML selects or calendars.
Use tabular-nums in Tailwind for all quantity/stock numbers.
Include data-testid on every clickable element or form field.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Order placed', 'Stock low').
Ensure dark/light contrast shift between the sidebar and main content area.
Keep background surfaces solid. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or surfaces that have content under them.
